rules: Map only when source class unambiguously matches ontology.
Do not auto-map crane→mobile_crane, tractor→bulldozer, shovel→excavator, other→concrete class.
Unmapped / ambiguous source classes are excluded from that class's AP or kept as source-only.

miniexcav_excavator_v1.interpretation: Not a negative-excavator set; every kept image has ≥1 excavator box. Unlabeled other machines must not be scored as FN.
